subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose update execution over a gateway-authenticated HTTP surface for fleet tools, and if so should it be a dedicated `/admin/update` contract or an allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The request gives network callers host update and restart authority, while current code intentionally exposes only `update.status` over Admin HTTP RPC and keeps `update.run` on the Gateway control-plane RPC surface.

options.title: Split and defer HTTP update authority
options.body: Keep the version metadata decision in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-approved security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose via Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `update.run` or a narrow wrapper to the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with private-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, target-version, and handoff proof requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to the existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and defer HTTP update authority
recommendation.body: Keep the version metadata decision in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-approved security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history across the admin HTTP RPC plugin, gateway HTTP/security docs, and adjacent version helpers.
